shape: <session | workflow | sessions; matches the shape part of kickoff_version>

expected_cost.tokens: <integer, present only when tokens are counted>

approach: <how the work is cut and why, in one paragraph a stranger can check against the spec>

waves.mode: <serial | parallel; a parallel wave holds at most implementers_concurrent units>

units.name: <short name; the unit branch is <launch>/<name>>
units.kind: <contracts | feature | integration | proof; exactly one contracts unit in the serial W0 unless no_contracts is set>
spec_refs: <B or E id this unit makes true; the dispatch carries these and no other B or E>
checks: <T id from the pinned tests map; never empty>
units.owner: <crew role that builds it, implementer by default>
paths: <glob this unit may write, inside the allowed paths>
units.pilot: <boolean; at least one unit of the first parallel wave is a pilot and runs before the rest>

risks.text: <what could go wrong, in observable terms>
risks.source: <where the risk came from: an explorer id, runlog, or the spec node>

gates.G1: <what the human reads at gate 1 to approve the plan>
gates.G2: <what the human reads at gate 2 to approve the contracts>
gates.G3: <what the human reads at gate 3 to end the run>

abandon_triggers.trigger: <the condition that stops the run, stated so it can be observed>
abandon_triggers.observable_by: <the event, command or file that shows it fired>

no_contracts.reason: <why this plan has no contracts unit; the key is absent when W0 holds one>
